fields.label: Address
fields.help: The IP address or beginning of the address range represented by this resource.

fields.label: Address Type
fields.help: The type of the address to reserve.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: IP Version
fields.help: The IP Version that will be used by this address.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The URL of the network in which to reserve the IP range.

fields.label: Prefix Length
fields.help: The prefix length of the IP range.
